newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Clariant sales rise nine pct in 1996.
newsitem.headline: Clariant sales rise nine pct in 1996.

text.p: Swiss chemicals concern Clariant AG said its group sales rose by 192 million Swiss francs in 1996 to 2.337 billion francs.
"This corresponds to a considerable increase of nine percent in Swiss franc terms, and seven percent in local currencies," Clariant said in a statement.
It said that favourable sales developments in the third quarter continued in the final quarter of 1996.
It also said that its earnings would show double-digit gains.
"The concern profit will, in line with expectations, show a double-digit increase in comparison to the previous year," it said.
